title: A BLAST LEAVES ITS SCAR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it (item 12, richer ground). A frag, a Howler shell or a tripwire mine left one flat dark oval that faded after 45 seconds, and a busy fight pushed it off the list even sooner. Every blast on open ground now burns a scorch into the floor with cracks running out of it and a scatter of debris, and it stays for the whole raid at no cost to draw. A shell that bursts on a roof leaves nothing on the ground under it. Nothing about play changes.
now: Frags, Howler shells and mines now burn a scorch with cracks and debris into the floor that stays all raid.
